record.content: Our category's buyers shortlist 3 vendors in week 1 and decide by week 3; they distrust vendor-written ROI claims.

interpretation.segmentation_implication: Target marketing efforts towards early stages of the buyer journey (weeks 1-3) to maximize visibility and influence.
interpretation.messaging_adjustment: Emphasize transparent, third-party verified ROI claims over vendor-written ones to build trust among buyers.
